assessment.nobel_worthiness: Horizon-scale imaging made black-hole predictions directly visible and established a powerful new observational window on gravity.
assessment.attribution: These names represent major leadership in the instrument, theoretical interpretation, and radio-interferometry foundations, though the result depended on a very large collaboration.
assessment.maturity: The 2019 image and later observations provide strong validation; the method is likely to keep producing important tests.
uncertainties: How to allocate credit fairly across the Event Horizon Telescope collaboration remains difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks transformed precision timekeeping and enable tests of fundamental physics as well as practical applications.
assessment.attribution: Katori and Ye made distinct, leading contributions to the clock concept and its experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: The principle has been independently realized and repeatedly improved over many years; its scientific and technological value is established.
uncertainties: The boundary between the original clock invention and subsequent advances by other groups needs careful attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: IceCube opened high-energy neutrino astronomy and demonstrated that the Universe can be studied through a new messenger.
assessment.attribution: Halzen and Karle are credible representatives of the detector's scientific conception and experimental realization, while the discovery itself was collaborative.
assessment.maturity: The astrophysical neutrino signal has been followed by additional observations and source studies, establishing a lasting field.
uncertainties: Individual credit for the detector and discovery is hard to separate from the large IceCube collaboration.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Precision maps of the cosmic microwave background established the acoustic structure of the early Universe and sharply constrained cosmology.
assessment.attribution: These names represent major contributions across space-based and ground-based measurements and later precision mapping, but the candidate's list omits key contributors to the earliest anisotropy discovery.
assessment.maturity: The measurements have been independently cross-checked and underpin a durable, quantitatively successful cosmological framework.
uncertainties: The proposed credit is incomplete for the discovery history and may not capture the decisive contributions across missions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The Kuiper Belt discovery revealed a major population of small Solar System bodies and changed understanding of planetary-system formation.
assessment.attribution: Jewitt and Luu are closely and clearly associated with the discovery.
assessment.maturity: Decades of observations have confirmed the belt and its diversity; its importance to planetary science is secure.
uncertainties: The distinction between a singular discovery and the subsequent broader mapping of the population deserves consideration.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The Higgs boson discovery completed a central part of the Standard Model and was a landmark in experimental particle physics.
assessment.attribution: These are leading figures in the ATLAS and CMS experiments, but a discovery of this scale cannot be reduced cleanly to a few individuals.
assessment.maturity: The signal was independently observed by two experiments and its properties have been extensively measured.
uncertainties: The Nobel's individual-recipient limit makes fair recognition of the thousands who built and operated both detectors challenging.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Silicon microstrip and hybrid pixel detectors made precise, high-rate particle tracking practical and enabled generations of major experiments.
assessment.attribution: The three names span important detector concepts and implementations, though the development drew on broad teams and parallel work.
assessment.maturity: These detector technologies have been used and refined for decades, with their lasting impact clear.
uncertainties: It is difficult to draw a defensible line around the decisive inventions and their individual inventors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The holographic principle and AdS/CFT duality reshaped theoretical physics and supplied a deep connection between gravity and quantum field theory.
assessment.attribution: These names capture central developments, but the credited list spans related ideas whose histories and individual contributions differ.
assessment.maturity: The duality is a productive and durable theoretical framework, though its physical relevance to our Universe has not been established experimentally.
uncertainties: The absence of direct empirical tests limits assessment of nature's realization of the framework.
A single prize citation may conflate distinct contributions to holography and gauge/gravity duality.
